name: Maruko Misaki
source:
Misaki is a newscaster for the school radio along with [url=/c98264]Shizuku[/url], as well as the DJ during lunch break; she also helps out with Student Council duties and preparing for school events, which makes her extremely busy. Misaki and [url=/c98319]Kairi[/url] are childhood friends. Kairi calls her "Maru-chan" and Misaki calls her "Little Lady". They often go places together during weekends.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
